scoring_justification: Headline quantities are the phase fractions themselves; no summary metric can be recomputed from raw artifacts; direct comparison to paper‑reported values with tolerance absorbs legitimate solver spread.

outputs.description: Phase volume fractions at the centreline for depths 0‑400 µm, comparing against paper‑reported values for case V2 within a fixed tolerance.
Depth where ledeburite fraction ≥ 0.9, compared to the experimental reference for case V2.

output_contract.notes: The hidden reference values were extracted from the paper’s simulated curves and measured layer thickness for case V2. The agent must implement the full coupled thermo‑metallurgical solver; using pre‑existing commercial software results is not accepted.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold phase fractions and layer thickness for case V2
hidden_assets.source_provenance: digitized from paper Figure 12 (phase fractions) and Figure 15 (layer thickness) for case V2
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted from published curves; values match the reference oracle solve.sh which writes the exact numbers
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: values are directly traceable to the paper’s own published results for the same case V2
